scenario_description:
Objective: A Tuesday early-release pickup for Mara needs a workable substitute before the school handoff window.
Emerging Need: Ben is available, but the school’s substitute-release prerequisite is not yet in place and requires guardian follow-through before a cutoff.
Decision Context: The clinic schedule is uncertain at first, then confirmed; the contact card supplies Ben’s release details while the stored school template supplies the governing authorization rule.
Consequence: If the prerequisite is handled while time remains, the pickup can proceed normally; after the cutoff, the family loses the intended prevention benefit before anyone reaches the school.

parameter.title: Mara early-release pickup window
parameter.description: Lincoln Elementary early dismissal; Talia marked family coverage tentative until clinic schedule is final.

parameter.content: Talia mentioned the clinic might run long Tuesday. I can take Mara at early release if she needs me; I’m pretty sure I’m not already on the school pickup list.

parameter.name: Benjamin Quill
parameter.notes: Uses legal name Benjamin Quill on his Illinois ID; prefers texts during workday.

parameter.subject: Fwd: Tuesday clinic extension confirmed
parameter.body: Forwarding for visibility: my Tuesday clinic block is now confirmed through 3:30 PM, with release not expected before 3:15. Ben, thank you for keeping the early-release window open.

parameter.content: I checked with the Lincoln attendance office just now: no guardian email authorizing me for today arrived before 10:00, and the school will not add a substitute to today's release list after that cutoff. I am keeping my lunch break available while we sort out a permitted alternative.
